# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We are committed to making participation in the ORCA project a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of background, identity, experience, or ability.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful, constructive, and considerate.
- Assume good intent while addressing impact clearly.
- Welcome different viewpoints and practical feedback.
- Focus on what is best for the project and its users.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, sexualized language or imagery, doxxing, trolling, and other unprofessional conduct are not acceptable.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior privately to the project maintainers through the security contact listed in `SECURITY.md`. Do not disclose sensitive details in a public issue.

Maintainers will review reports fairly, protect confidentiality where possible, and take action appropriate to the circumstances.

## Scope

This code applies in project spaces and wherever an individual is representing the ORCA project.

This document is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1.
